decisions.reason: As a map.apps add-on that received visible launch investment and has now been kept for several years, management is inclined to continue it and interpret any weaker uptake as a temporary or niche-demand issue rather than admit failure.
Because this GIS platform is a flagship product line tied to the firm’s stated strategic direction, the sunk investment and public commitment make withdrawal within the next year very unlikely.

This mobile field data capture software sits close to the firm’s core integrated geospatial offering, so management is likely to justify continued support and attribute any disappointment to customer rollout cycles or project timing.

As a web-map search extension within the firm’s established solution stack, it is easier to discontinue than the flagship platform but still benefits from accumulated development commitment and complementarities with existing products.
